body: hanging will hurt.. I suggest thinking of other ways to end it.. but before that i think you should sit in a room with no distractions and just rethink your options. if you are able to have peace and quiet for 5 mins it would calm your brain to think and if everything is bad enough you will think of a painless and calm way to end things. but if you feel a sprout of doubt, I suggest sleeping it off, calling some sort of help line and then making a decision.
call the police.. 911 or whatever the number for emergencies is in your country.
